euclidean_R3.occupied_sources: all allowable training-only occupied pilot islands after heldout-block exclusion, across regional pools

if_nonempty.nearest: minimum haversine distance to occupied source

if_empty.reason: pi*Earth-radius is the maximum possible great-circle distance, so the sentinel is strictly beyond any realizable source distance

graph_C.occupied_sources: allowable training-only occupied pilot islands reachable in the target's frozen response-independent regional-pool graph after heldout-block exclusion

if_nonempty.nearest: minimum graph shortest-path distance to occupied reachable source

if_empty.reason: a connected positive-edge graph has a simple shortest path with at most n-1 edges, so this response-independent bound is strictly beyond any finite frozen graph path

modeling.distance_features: apply log1p after sentinel/finite distance is assigned
modeling.pressure_features: apply log1p after pressure is assigned
modeling.standardization: freeze from cross-fitted pilot training rows only
